title: KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents
title_zh: KnowGPO：面向搜索智能体的知识分组策略优化

paragraphs.en: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO , a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/KnowGPO .

paragraphs.en: LLM-based deep search agents have become a powerful paradigm for knowledge-intensive problem solving, coordinating multi-turn search, evidence inspection, query reformulation, and termination decisions through language-model reasoning ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Unlike conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which typically follows a one-pass retrieve-then-read pipeline ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) , deep search agents iteratively formulate queries, inspect evidence, update beliefs, and decide when to stop ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2025c ) . This makes deep search a long-horizon sequential decision problem, where success depends on adaptive decisions about what to search, what evidence to keep, and when to terminate . Because supervised fine-tuning mainly imitates surface behavior ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) and cannot optimize such strategic decisions, reinforcement learning has become central to training competitive deep search agents ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的深度搜索智能体已成为知识密集型问题求解的一种强大范式，它通过语言模型的推理能力协调多轮搜索、证据检验、查询重构和终止决策（Yao 等，2022；Zhang 等，2026a）。 与传统的检索增强生成（RAG）不同——后者通常遵循“先检索、后阅读”的单次流程（Lewis 等，2021；Gao 等，2024；Zhao 等，2024）——深度搜索智能体则通过迭代方式构建查询、检验证据、更新信念并决定何时停止（Nakano 等，2021；Li 等，2025c）。 这使得深度搜索成为一个长期序列决策问题，其成功取决于对搜索内容、保留证据以及终止时机的适应性决策。 由于监督微调主要模仿表层行为（Nakano 等，2021；Schick 等，2023），无法优化此类策略性决策，因此强化学习已成为训练具有竞争力的深度搜索智能体的核心方法（Guo 等，2025；Jin 等，2025；Song 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: However, applying reinforcement learning to deep search agents encounters three coupled difficulties in credit assignment (Figure 1 ). First, terminal outcome rewards used by group-relative methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) are uniformly broadcast to every action, so a single final reward cannot reveal which intermediate decisions were useful, redundant, or harmful. Second, recent process-supervision methods such as GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) that align trajectories by their intermediate states require state recurrence across trajectories, yet deep search rollouts seldom revisit the same observable state even when they acquire the same evidence. Third, dense process rewards derived from changes in the model’s predicted answer probability, as in IGPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , or from learned critics and rubric-based reward models ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , provide denser signals but are driven by model-internal beliefs or learned proxies rather than by externally verified knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将强化学习应用于深度搜索智能体时，在信用分配方面会遇到三个相互关联的难题（图 1）。 首先，像 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024；Jin 等人，2025；Song 等人，2025；Lu 等人，2025；Li 等人，2025b；Liu 等人，2025）这类基于群体的相对方法所使用的终端结果奖励会被统一广播到每个动作上，因此单个最终奖励无法揭示哪些中间决策是有益的、冗余的或有害的。 其次，近期的一些过程监督方法（如 GiGPO（Feng 等人，2025）），通过轨迹的中间状态来对齐轨迹，但这些方法需要轨迹之间存在状态重复，而深度搜索展开过程很少会再次访问相同的可观察状态，即使它们获得了相同的证据。 第三，像 IGPO（Wang 等人，2026）中那样，从模型预测答案概率的变化中获得的密集过程奖励，或者来自已学习评论员和基于评分标准的奖励模型（Shi 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026b；Lu 等人，2026）的奖励，虽然提供了更密集的信号，但这些信号是由模型内部的信念或已学习的代理指标驱动的，而非由外部验证的知识驱动。

paragraphs.en: We propose Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization (KnowGPO) , a RL framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, we decompose the information required to derive the correct answer into a set of atomic knowledge conditions. At every step of a trajectory, we represent its state by the subset of conditions it has satisfied, called its knowledge state . We further define incremental knowledge gain , the increase in satisfied conditions between consecutive steps, as a process reward that scores each action’s immediate contribution. While knowledge-state grouping ensures only semantically comparable steps are contrasted, incremental gain provides the dense signal within each group, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without a learned critic. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, yielding step-level advantages that combine with episode-level outcome advantages through a single mixing coefficient. The result is fine-grained credit assignment for long-horizon deep search without observation matching, without dependence on the model’s own confidence, and without a learned reward model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了知识分组策略优化（KnowGPO），这是一种强化学习框架，它根据智能体在任务中获取的相关知识而非表面观察来对齐轨迹。 对于每个查询，我们将推导出正确答案所需的信息分解为一组原子化的知识条件。 在轨迹的每一步，我们通过智能体已满足的条件子集来表示其状态，并将其称为知识状态。 我们进一步将增量知识获取——即连续步骤之间已满足条件的增加量——定义为过程奖励，用于评估每个动作的直接贡献。 虽然知识状态分组确保了只有语义上可比较的步骤才会被对比，但增量知识获取为每个组内提供了密集的信号，从而无需学习批评者即可实现精细的功劳分配。 共享相同知识状态的轨迹会被分组进行组内比较，由此产生的步骤级优势会通过一个混合系数与回合级结果优势相结合。 最终实现了长时程深度搜索的精细功劳分配，且无需观察匹配、不依赖模型自身的置信度，也无需学习奖励模型。

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3-8B with KnowGPO on three challenging deep search benchmarks: Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA. KnowGPO improves over outcome-only GRPO by 2.0% to 5.9% and consistently outperforms recent process-supervision baselines including GiGPO and IGPO, with the resulting 8B agent matching or surpassing open-source systems of up to 32B parameters.

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that performs credit assignment in a query-specific knowledge state space rather than over surface observations, enabling within-group comparison across semantically equivalent trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 KnowGPO，这是一种强化学习框架，它不是在表层观察上执行信用分配，而是在与查询相关的知识状态空间中执行信用分配，从而使得在语义等价的轨迹之间能够进行组内比较。

paragraphs.en: We introduce incremental knowledge gain as a process reward grounded in the environment, providing dense step-level supervision without observation matching, learned critics, or reliance on model-internal probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种增量知识获取机制，将其作为基于环境的流程奖励，无需观察匹配、学习到的评判器或依赖模型内部概率，即可提供密集的步级监督。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that KnowGPO outperforms outcome-based and recent process-supervision baselines by 3.8% to 4.2% across three deep search benchmarks, with an 8B agent matching or surpassing open-source systems of up to 32B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个深度搜索基准测试中证明，KnowGPO 在性能上比基于结果和近期流程监督的基线模型高出 3.8% 至 4.2%，其中 8B 智能体的表现与参数高达 32B 的开源系统相当甚至更优。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable outcome rewards has become the dominant paradigm for post-training deep search agents. Early systems train models to interleave search and reasoning through outcome-based optimization on multi-hop QA ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , showing that group-relative methods such as GRPO scale to multi-turn tool use without learned value functions. Subsequent work scales this paradigm along two axes: harder data through knowledge graphs, web exploration, and synthetic multi-hop generation ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Du et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Chu et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026e ; Team et al., 2026d ) , and refined reward shaping and policy gradient stability for long-horizon rollouts ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) . Despite these advances, the supervisory signal in most systems remains a binary reward at the end of each trajectory, leaving the contribution of search decisions inside long rollouts unidentified.
paragraphs.zh: 采用可验证结果奖励的强化学习已成为训练后深度搜索智能体的主流范式。 早期系统通过基于多跳问答的任务进行结果导向优化，训练模型将搜索与推理交替执行（Jin et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025），这表明像 GRPO 这样的群体相对方法无需学习价值函数，也能扩展到多轮工具使用场景。 后续研究沿两个方向扩展了这一范式：一方面通过知识图谱、网络探索和合成多跳生成来增加数据难度（Lu et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025b；Liu et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025a；Du et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2025；Chu et al., 2026；Team et al., 2026e；Team et al., 2026d）；另一方面则针对长时程展开优化奖励塑造策略和策略梯度稳定性（Wu et al., 2026；Dong et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025；Tang et al., 2025）。 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数系统中的监督信号仍然是每条轨迹结束时的二元奖励，导致长时程展开过程中搜索决策的具体贡献仍无法被识别。

paragraphs.en: A growing line of work aims to address long-horizon credit assignment through process-level supervision. GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) extends GRPO with anchor-state grouping, computing step-level advantages by matching trajectories that revisit the same environment state; this mechanism requires reliable state recurrence, which is rare in deep search where retrieved contents and reasoning histories are open-ended. IGPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) instead derives dense step rewards from the model’s own probability of producing the correct answer, sidestepping state matching but anchoring the signal to internal confidence that can be biased by long, noisy retrieved contexts. A parallel direction introduces externally grounded supervision through learned reward models or rubric decompositions ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , providing denser feedback than outcome rewards but relying on learned proxies whose calibration is itself a research question, and without producing step groupings that make semantically equivalent decisions directly comparable across trajectories. KnowGPO instead anchors credit assignment to an externally verifiable representation of progress, the set of satisfied atomic knowledge conditions, and uses this representation as both the grouping criterion for within-group comparison and the basis of a process reward grounded in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究致力于通过过程级监督来解决长期信用分配问题。 GiGPO（Feng 等人，2025）在 GRPO 的基础上引入了锚定状态分组机制，通过匹配重复访问相同环境状态的轨迹来计算步骤级优势；该机制需要可靠的状态重复性，但在深度搜索中却较为罕见，因为检索到的内容和推理历史都是开放式的。 IGPO（Wang 等人，2026）则转而从模型自身生成正确答案的概率中推导出密集的步骤奖励，从而避免了状态匹配问题，但将信号锚定在内部置信度上，而这一置信度可能受到冗长且充满噪声的检索上下文的影响。 一个平行的研究方向通过已学习的奖励模型或评分标准分解（Zhang 等人，2026b；Zhang 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2025；Shi 等人，2025）引入了外部锚定的监督机制，这种机制比结果奖励能提供更密集的反馈，但依赖于已学习的代理指标，而这些指标的校准本身仍是一个研究问题，并且它并未生成能使语义等价的决策在跨轨迹比较中直接可比的步骤分组。 KnowGPO 则将信用分配锚定在一种外部可验证的进展表示上——即已满足的原子知识条件集合，并将这种表示既用作组内比较的分组标准，也用作基于环境的过程奖励的基础。

paragraphs.en: We formulate deep search as a multi-turn sequential decision process. Given a query Q Q and a reference answer y ∗ y^{*} , an agent interacts with a retrieval environment over time steps t ∈ { 1 , … , T } t\in\{1,\dots,T\} . At each step the agent produces a reasoning trace and an action a t ∈ { search , answer } a_{t}\in\{\texttt{search},\texttt{answer}\} from its policy π θ ( ⋅ ∣ h t , Q ) \pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid h_{t},Q) , where h t = ( a 1 , o 1 , … , a t − 1 , o t − 1 ) h_{t}=(a_{1},o_{1},\dots,a_{t-1},o_{t-1}) is the interaction history and o t o_{t} is the observation returned by the environment (e.g., retrieved documents for search , or a terminal signal for answer ). A complete trajectory is denoted τ = ( a 1 , o 1 , … , a T , o T ) \tau=(a_{1},o_{1},\dots,a_{T},o_{T}) and terminates with a binary outcome reward R ⁡ ( τ ) = 𝕀 ⁡ ( ans ​ ( τ ) = y ∗ ) R(\tau)=\mathbb{I}(\text{ans}(\tau)=y^{*}) . We build on group-relative policy optimization, which estimates advantages from a group of N N trajectories sampled for the same Q Q and avoids learning a separate value network. The challenge addressed throughout this section is that R ⁡ ( τ ) R(\tau) alone provides no signal for distinguishing useful, redundant, or harmful steps inside a long-horizon trajectory.

paragraphs.en: A central design choice in KnowGPO is to abstract the progress of a search trajectory through the task-relevant knowledge it has acquired, rather than through its surface observations. paragraphs.en: We compare KnowGPO against three representative reinforcement learning approaches, all trained from the same SFT checkpoint with identical data and tool environments. GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) uses only the binary outcome reward and is the dominant baseline in current open-source systems. GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) introduces step-level credit assignment by grouping steps that revisit the same intermediate state and computing within-group advantages from discounted future returns. IGPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) assigns each step a dense reward equal to the increase in the model’s predicted probability of the correct answer. In addition, we report numbers from several state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary deep search agents for context; differences in training data, context length, and tool stacks limit direct comparison, and we mark such systems separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 KnowGPO 与三种具有代表性的强化学习方法进行了比较，这些方法均使用相同的 SFT 检查点、完全一致的数据和工具环境进行训练。 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）仅使用二元结果奖励，并且是当前开源系统中的主要基线方法。 GiGPO（Feng 等人，2025）通过将重复访问相同中间状态的步骤分组，并根据折扣后的未来回报计算组内优势，从而引入了步级信用分配机制。 IGPO（Wang 等人，2026）为每个步骤分配一个密集奖励，该奖励等于模型预测正确答案概率的增加量。 此外，我们还报告了若干当前最先进的开源和专有深度搜索智能体的相关数据作为背景参考；由于训练数据、上下文长度和工具栈存在差异，这些系统难以直接比较，因此我们将其单独标注。

paragraphs.en: All RL approaches improve over SFT, confirming that explicit policy optimization is necessary for deep search agents. However, existing step-level methods show considerable cross-dataset variability: GiGPO degrades by 2.0% on Xbench-2505 relative to GRPO despite winning on BrowseComp-ZH, and IGPO matches GRPO on Xbench-2505 but barely improves on BrowseComp-ZH. KnowGPO is the only method that improves on every split, gaining 5.9% on BrowseComp-ZH and 5.2% on GAIA over GRPO, and exceeding the strongest step-level baseline by 1.5% and 2.3% on these two benchmarks. The averaged gain over the SFT initialization is 8.5%. We attribute this consistency to the fact that knowledge-grouped credit signals do not depend on either surface state recurrence or stable model confidence, both of which are particularly fragile on noisier benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 所有强化学习（RL）方法都优于 SFT，这证实了深度搜索智能体需要显式的策略优化。 然而，现有的步骤级方法在不同数据集上的表现存在显著差异：尽管 GiGPO 在 BrowseComp-ZH 上表现更优，但在 Xbench-2505 上的性能相比 GRPO 下降了 2.0%；而 IGPO 在 Xbench-2505 上与 GRPO 表现相当，但在 BrowseComp-ZH 上几乎没有提升。 KnowGPO 是唯一在所有数据分割上都有提升的方法：它在 BrowseComp-ZH 和 GAIA 上的性能分别比 GRPO 提升了 5.9% 和 5.2%，并且在这两个基准测试中分别超过了最强的步骤级基线方法 1.5% 和 2.3%。 相对于 SFT 初始化的平均提升为 8.5%。 我们将这种一致性归因于知识分组信用信号既不完全依赖表面状态的重复性，也不依赖稳定的模型置信度，而这两者在噪声较多的基准测试中尤其脆弱。

paragraphs.en: On BrowseComp-ZH, KnowGPO reaches 38.8%, surpassing the same-scale WebExplorer-8B by 6.8% and the 32B WebSailor-32B and DeepDive-32B by 13.3% and 9.1% respectively, and trailing the strongest open-source system DeepMiner-32B-RL by only 1.3%. On Xbench-2505 it reaches 48.0%, outperforming the 8B MiroThinker-v1.0 by 12.6%. These results show that knowledge-grouped credit assignment narrows the gap to substantially larger open-source systems without proprietary data or larger backbones. A gap to proprietary systems remains, for example 23.5% to Kimi-K2.5 on BrowseComp-ZH and 28.1% to Claude-4-Sonnet on GAIA, which we attribute to training data scale, model capacity, and inference-time optimization beyond our scope.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 tracks validation accuracy on Xbench-2505 in RL training. All four methods start from the same SFT checkpoint and follow comparable trajectories during the first 16 steps, after which they diverge. KnowGPO opens a clear gap by around step 20 and plateaus near step 32 at roughly 50%, while GRPO, GiGPO, and IGPO settle below 46%. paragraphs.en: Table 4 decomposes KnowGPO against GRPO. Adding incremental knowledge gain to GRPO ( + Δ \Delta KG , applied without knowledge-state grouping) improves over GRPO by 1.0% to 2.8% across benchmarks, confirming that knowledge-grounded step rewards are useful even without proper grouping. Further introducing knowledge-state grouping (KnowGPO, full) yields an additional 1.0% to 4.2%, with the largest gain (+4.2%) on BrowseComp-ZH. The role of grouping is to restrict normalization to steps that share the same prior knowledge state, so that within-group comparison contrasts decisions made from the same epistemic position rather than across mixed positions; the ablation isolates this effect from the choice of process reward.

paragraphs.en: We sample 500 queries from Xbench and BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) and rollout the SFT checkpoint up to 16 times per query, producing 5,922 valid trajectories with 55,571 steps after filtering. We compare three grouping anchors: observation-anchored , matching steps by BGE-large cosine similarity over retrieved contents at threshold 0.9 (the protocol used by GiGPO); action-anchored , matching steps by similarity of generated queries; and knowledge-anchored (ours), matching steps by exact equality of accumulated knowledge state. Grouping quality is measured by the effective step ratio (ESR, fraction of steps in non-singleton groups), the singleton ratio, the mean non-singleton group size, and the cross-rollout coverage (average number of distinct rollouts per non-singleton group). Formal definitions are in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Xbench 和 BrowseComp（Wei 等人，2025）中采样了 500 条查询，并将 SFT 检查点每条查询最多展开 16 次，过滤后得到了包含 55,571 个步骤的 5,922 条有效轨迹。 我们比较了三种分组锚点：观察锚定法，即通过 BGE-large 在检索内容上的余弦相似度（阈值为 0.9）来匹配步骤（这是 GiGPO 使用的方案）；动作锚定法，即通过生成查询的相似度来匹配步骤；以及知识锚定法（我们的方法），即通过累积知识状态的完全相等来匹配步骤。 分组质量通过有效步骤比率（ESR，即非单元素组中步骤的比例）、单元素组比率、非单元素组的平均大小以及跨展开覆盖度（每个非单元素组中不同展开的平均数量）进行衡量。 正式定义见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports the five metrics. Observation-based grouping, the anchor used by GiGPO, leaves only 51.8% of steps inside non-singleton groups and produces 79.4% singletons, which means most intended step-level comparisons cannot be executed: the within-group advantage degenerates to comparing a step with itself, providing no learning signal. Action-based grouping improves ESR to 79.4% but its singleton ratio is still 72.0%, indicating that even when two trajectories issue similar queries, the evidence they end up acquiring is rarely comparable. Knowledge-based grouping raises ESR to 97.8% and reduces singletons to 19.0%, while keeping cross-rollout coverage (4.66) close to the highest value across anchors. This last metric is important: it confirms that the gain is not an artifact of merging adjacent steps within the same rollout, but reflects alignment of semantically equivalent steps across independent trajectories. A qualitative case in Appendix D shows two steps with 0.987 retrieval similarity that are correctly separated by the knowledge anchor (one has acquired 0 of 12 conditions, the other 8 of 12), illustrating that surface similarity can hide drastic differences in actual search progress.

paragraphs.en: Reducing redundant search is easy if the policy simply stops earlier on every query, but this would harm hard cases. To test for this failure mode, we partition 500 test queries by joint solving outcome and compare average search turns (Table 6 ). On queries solved exclusively by KnowGPO, KnowGPO uses 9.83 turns versus 11.55 for GRPO, a clear reduction in redundant exploration. On queries solved only by GRPO, KnowGPO still uses 10.36 turns, and on queries where both methods fail, it uses 10.85, the longest of all subsets. The agent does not uniformly shorten search; it shortens search when evidence becomes sufficient and continues searching when evidence remains scarce. A representative trajectory comparison in Appendix G shows GRPO overshooting a correct intermediate answer by four additional turns and overwriting it with a wrong one, a failure mode KnowGPO avoids.
paragraphs.zh: 如果策略在每次查询中都提前停止，那么减少冗余搜索会很轻松，但这会对困难案例造成损害。 为了测试这种失败模式，我们根据联合求解结果对 500 条测试查询进行划分，并比较平均搜索步数（表 6）。 在仅由 KnowGPO 解决的查询中，KnowGPO 使用了 9.83 个步骤，而 GRPO 则使用了 11.55 个步骤，这明显减少了冗余探索。 在仅由 GRPO 解决的查询中，KnowGPO 仍然使用了 10.36 个步骤；而在两种方法都失败的查询中，它使用了 10.85 个步骤，这是所有子集中最长的。 智能体并非均匀地缩短搜索过程；当证据足够时它会缩短搜索，而当证据仍然稀缺时则会继续搜索。 附录 G 中一个典型的轨迹比较显示，GRPO 在正确中间答案之后又多走了四个步骤，并用错误答案覆盖了它，而 KnowGPO 避免了这种失败模式。

paragraphs.en: A natural concern with structured process supervision is overhead. We profile per-iteration time over three training epochs (Figure 4 ). The training budget is dominated by operations shared with GRPO: trajectory generation (2,574s), policy update (583s), and probability computation (310s). KnowGPO-specific operations are knowledge verification (356s), incremental gain computation (2.73s), and group construction (0.03s). Verification runs asynchronously and overlaps with the next rollout, so its wall-clock cost is hidden behind generation; the two pure-bookkeeping operations together account for less than 0.08% of the budget. Knowledge-grouped credit assignment is therefore essentially free compared to GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化流程监督的一个自然担忧是额外开销。 我们对三个训练周期内的每次迭代时间进行了分析（图4）。 训练预算主要由与GRPO共享的操作构成：轨迹生成（2,574秒）、策略更新（583秒）和概率计算（310秒）。 KnowGPO特有的操作包括知识验证（356秒）、增量收益计算（2.73秒）和组构建（0.03秒）。 验证过程异步运行并与下一次展开重叠，因此其实际耗时被隐藏在了生成过程中；两项纯粹的记账操作合计占预算的比例不足0.08%。 因此，与GRPO相比，基于知识组的信用分配几乎不产生额外成本。

paragraphs.en: We presented KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that assigns credit by aligning deep search trajectories through the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired, rather than through their surface observations. KnowGPO groups steps under matched knowledge states and uses incremental knowledge gain as a process reward grounded in the environment. Across Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA, KnowGPO improves over outcome-only and process-supervision baselines by 3.8% to 4.2%, with an 8B agent matching 32B open-source systems at training cost comparable to GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 KnowGPO，这是一种强化学习框架，它通过将深度搜索轨迹与其所获取的任务相关知识进行对齐来分配信用，而不是基于表面的观察。 KnowGPO 将处于匹配知识状态下的步骤进行分组，并利用增量知识获取作为基于环境的流程奖励。 在 Xbench、BrowseComp-ZH 和 GAIA 上，KnowGPO 相比仅基于结果和流程监督的基线模型性能提升了 3.8% 至 4.2%，其中 8B 智能体的表现与 32B 开源系统相当，而训练成本与 GRPO 相近。

paragraphs.en: KnowGPO assumes that progress in the target task can be characterized by a finite set of verifiable knowledge conditions, which fits knowledge-intensive search but not more open-ended agentic tasks whose progress is harder to discretize. The fidelity of the knowledge state also depends on an LLM verifier, and although we use a strong external model with monotonic accumulation to suppress transient noise, residual errors can still propagate into step-level advantages. Our construction pipeline additionally requires at least one successful reference trajectory per query to ground entity placeholders, which limits applicability to settings where successful rollouts are reachable at reasonable cost. Finally, all experiments use Qwen3-8B; whether the effects we observe transfer to substantially smaller or larger backbones, or to reasoning-trained initializations, remains to be verified.

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides the full pseudocode of KnowGPO and the explicit training objective used for parameter updates. The procedure begins by sampling N N trajectories for each query and running the LLM verifier at every step to construct the knowledge state 𝐬 i , t \mathbf{s}_{i,t} . Trajectories are then grouped by their preceding knowledge state, and step-level advantages are computed by within-group normalization of incremental knowledge gain. The episode-level outcome advantage and the step-level knowledge-grouped advantage are combined with a single mixing coefficient ω \omega and used as the per-token advantage in a PPO-style clipped objective.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了 KnowGPO 的完整伪代码以及用于参数更新的明确训练目标。 该流程首先为每个查询采样 N 条轨迹，并在每一步运行 LLM 验证器以构建知识状态 𝐬 i , t \mathbf{s}_{i,t}。 随后，根据轨迹的前序知识状态对其进行分组，并通过组内增量知识增益的归一化计算步级优势。 回合级结果优势与步级知识分组优势通过单个混合系数 ω \omega 结合，并作为 PPO 风格裁剪目标中的每词元优势使用。

paragraphs.en: The following example illustrates why surface similarity is unreliable. Trajectory 6 has acquired 0 of 12 knowledge conditions (still in exploration), while Trajectory 10 has acquired 8 of 12 (the target entity has been identified). Yet the retrieved-content embeddings of the two trajectories’ steps reach cosine similarity 0.987 because both happen to mention similar generic terms (Chinese fir, forest research, research laboratory). Observation-anchored grouping clusters the two steps together and ends up comparing an exploration step with a verification step. Knowledge-anchored grouping correctly separates them because their knowledge states differ.
paragraphs.zh: 以下示例说明了为何表面相似性并不可靠。 轨迹 6 已满足 12 个知识条件中的 0 个（仍处于探索阶段），而轨迹 10 已满足其中的 8 个（目标实体已被识别）。 然而，由于两条轨迹的步骤恰好提到了相似的通用术语（中国冷杉、森林研究、研究实验室），它们检索到的内容嵌入的余弦相似度达到了 0.987。 以观察为锚点的分组将这两个步骤聚类在一起，最终导致将一个探索步骤与一个验证步骤进行比较。 以知识为锚点的分组则能正确地将它们区分开来，因为两者的知识状态不同。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides the full implementation details of KnowGPO and its baselines, organized into three subsections: tool environment, training configuration, and prompt formats.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了 KnowGPO 及其基线模型的全部实现细节，内容分为三个子部分：工具环境、训练配置和提示格式。

paragraphs.en: The interactive environment exposes a single search action that routes queries to Xhub Search for Chinese queries or Google Search for English queries, with language detected via Unicode character ranges. The engine accepts batch inputs and returns the top-10 results per query, each comprising a title, URL, and snippet. To bound the context length consumed by retrieved evidence, snippets are compressed to an average of 300 tokens by a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B summarization model that preserves entities and key claims while removing boilerplate. Temporal sensitivity detection biases retrieval toward recent content for time-sensitive queries.
paragraphs.zh: 该交互式环境仅提供一个搜索动作：对于中文查询，会将请求路由至 Xhub Search；对于英文查询，则路由至 Google Search，语言类型通过 Unicode 字符范围进行识别。 该引擎支持批量输入，并为每条查询返回前 10 个结果，每个结果包含标题、URL 和摘要片段。 为限制检索证据所消耗上下文长度的上限，摘要片段会由一个经过微调的 Qwen3-8B 摘要模型进行压缩，平均压缩至 300 个词元，同时保留实体和关键主张，并移除冗余内容。 时间敏感性检测机制会使系统在处理时间敏感查询时更倾向于检索近期内容。

paragraphs.en: We first SFT Qwen3-8B on a corpus of approximately 8,100 deep search trajectories, constructed by combining human demonstrations with model-assisted annotation. SFT runs on 8 A100 GPUs using LLaMAFactory with standard causal language modeling, for 3 epochs at learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and effective batch size 64. The resulting checkpoint achieves over 98.5% format accuracy on ReAct-style tool invocations and is the shared initialization for all RL methods we compare.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在一个包含约 8,100 条深度搜索轨迹的语料库上对 Qwen3-8B 进行监督微调（SFT），这些轨迹由人类示范与模型辅助标注相结合构建而成。 SFT 在 8 块 A100 GPU 上运行，使用 LLaMAFactory 和标准的因果语言建模方法，训练 3 个周期，学习率为 2 × 10⁻⁵，有效批量大小为 64。 最终得到的检查点在 ReAct 风格的工具调用任务中实现了超过 98.5% 的格式准确率，并且是我们所比较的所有强化学习（RL）方法共用的初始化模型。

paragraphs.en: Following SFT, we apply KnowGPO and the three RL baselines. Training data is selected from the same source distribution as SFT but filtered to the zone of proximal development , defined as queries with pass@5 ∈ [ 0.4 , 0.6 ] \in[0.4,0.6] on the SFT checkpoint. This yields 649 high-quality training queries. RL runs on 64 NVIDIA H20 GPUs using verl at learning rate 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , batch size 32 prompts with 16 rollouts each, KL penalty β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 , for 3 training epochs. All RL methods share these settings; they differ only in the advantage estimator and reward design.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SFT 之后，我们应用了 KnowGPO 和三种 RL 基线方法。 训练数据选自与 SFT 相同的源分布，但经过筛选，仅保留最近发展区内的数据，即那些在 SFT 检查点上 pass@5 ∈ [0.4, 0.6] 的查询。 由此获得了 649 条高质量的训练查询。 RL 训练在 64 块 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上运行，使用 verl，学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁶，批量大小为 32 个提示，每个提示进行 16 次展开，KL 惩罚项 β = 0.01，共训练 3 个周期。 所有 RL 方法均共享这些设置；它们仅在优势估计器和奖励设计上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The case below is typical of the GRPO-only failure region and illustrates a behavior KnowGPO avoids. The query asks for a specific word quoted in an academic article. Both methods recover the correct word by step 8. KnowGPO terminates because its knowledge state is saturated; GRPO continues for four more turns, retrieves paraphrastic snippets containing competing surface tokens ( soften, satirize ), and overwrites its earlier correct answer. The example shows that absent a stopping signal grounded in actual evidence, additional search can actively destroy a correct intermediate answer.
paragraphs.zh: 以下案例是仅使用 GRPO 时典型失败区域的典型示例，并展示了 KnowGPO 所避免的一种行为。 该查询要求提供一个学术文章中引用的特定词语。 两种方法都在第 8 步恢复了正确的词语。 KnowGPO 因知识状态饱和而终止；GRPO 则继续运行了四轮，检索到了包含竞争性表层词项（soften、satirize）的改写片段，并覆盖了其之前给出的正确答案。 该示例表明，若缺乏基于实际证据的停止信号，额外的搜索过程可能会主动破坏一个正确的中间答案。
